reason: The Nov4 inspection found seven image-cache generations using11561143827 bytes while scheduled artifact cleanup could see no cache work. Five obsolete caches were safely pruned manually; add the same bounded retention to the existing hourly signed cleanup plan/result so it does not recur.
implementation: Only the Root Main lanrith-build-v1-Linux-X64 namespace is managed. Keep the newest cache for each of the latest two successful release sources, protect two-hour access and one 24-hour failed-release cache, and limit deletion to20 entries per run. Other repositories, branches and keys are excluded. Both planning and deletion check for active/queued workflows; deletion rechecks producers, immutable cache metadata and the retained floor. A new consumer racing the final check can get a cold-cache miss; cache authentication and all build/security gates remain enforced.
traceability: Cache-only work activates the existing has-artifacts gate. The nested cache plan is signed and immutably archived before the existing restricted Actions-write job executes it. Actual deletions, absences, safe deferrals and any partial failure remain in the signed result. Empty cleanup still uploads and publishes nothing.

security_note.risk_domain: CI/cache API authorization and storage exhaustion
security_note.assets: Current successful cache generations, active consumers, retained retry data, source/release evidence and credentials
security_note.trust_boundary: GitHub cache metadata and downloaded cleanup plans are independently revalidated before each scoped deletion; untrusted cache contents are never restored or executed.
abuse_cases: Forged cache IDs or altered policy must not delete current cache generations.
Foreign branches, unknown keys, missing producer identity or incomplete pagination must not authorize deletion.
A new consumer, access or rerun after planning must stop or defer the affected deletion.
External cache expiry must be recorded as absence, not a claimed deletion.
security_note.controls: Allowlisted repository/ref/key and actual completed producer; two retained successful sources; fixed policy/budgets; fresh plan; per-deletion metadata and consumer rechecks; no new token permission.
security_note.validation: Seventeen negative/positive retention tests, complete938-test suite and actual live read-only planner; full hosted/native checks remain mandatory.
security_note.residual_risk: A consumer starting after the last recheck can receive a cache miss and rebuild. Unknown or active work is preserved even if that temporarily retains more cache storage.

local_validation.independent_human_source_approval: required after all hosted CI passes

approval: Fresh actual independent human review of the final source after all required hosted builds pass. No previous approval or App source approval is reused.
deployment_status: Prepared source only; no protected merge, live scheduled cache deletion or new release is claimed.
